  • Method Details

    • tableName

      public DynamoDBSaver.Builder tableName(String tableName)
      Name of the DynamoDB table. Required.

    • stateSerializer

      public <State extends AgentState> DynamoDBSaver.Builder stateSerializer(StateSerializer<State> stateSerializer)
      The state serializer used to convert Map<String,Object> state to/from bytes. Required.

    • plainTextStateSerializerLegacyMode

      public DynamoDBSaver.Builder plainTextStateSerializerLegacyMode(boolean mode)
      Enables compatibility mode for PlainTextStateSerializer-based payloads. When true, the JSON payload is stored as a serialized Java String (binary). Ignored if the serializer is not a PlainTextStateSerializer.

    • ttlSeconds

      public DynamoDBSaver.Builder ttlSeconds(long ttlSeconds)
      Optional time-to-live in seconds. When set, every item written to DynamoDB will carry a ttl attribute (epoch seconds) so the table's TTL feature can automatically expire old checkpoints.

    • createTableIfNotExists

      public DynamoDBSaver.Builder createTableIfNotExists(boolean create)
      When true, the table is created (via CreateTable) if it does not already exist. Automatically implies createTableIfNotExists = true when dropTableFirst(boolean) is also set.

    • dropTableFirst

      public DynamoDBSaver.Builder dropTableFirst(boolean drop)
      When true, the table is deleted and recreated on startup. Implies createTableIfNotExists = true. Useful for tests.

    • dynamoDbClient

      public DynamoDBSaver.Builder dynamoDbClient(software.amazon.awssdk.services.dynamodb.DynamoDbClient client)
      Inject a fully configured DynamoDbClient. Required.

    • s3Bucket

      public DynamoDBSaver.Builder s3Bucket(String s3Bucket)
      S3 bucket name for large-payload offloading. When set, payloads exceeding 350KB are automatically stored in S3 instead of DynamoDB.

    • s3KeyPrefix

      public DynamoDBSaver.Builder s3KeyPrefix(String s3KeyPrefix)
      Optional prefix prepended to all S3 keys. Useful for bucket-level isolation between environments or applications.

    • s3Client

      public DynamoDBSaver.Builder s3Client(software.amazon.awssdk.services.s3.S3Client s3Client)
      Inject a pre-configured S3Client. Required if an s3Bucket is configured.

    • build

      public DynamoDBSaver build()
